title: For the relief of Paula Valentina Albornoz Hernández, Eliana Karina Hernández Peranquive, Nicole Alejandra Albornoz Hernández, and Leonardo Albornoz Rodríguez.
latestAction: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary, and in addition to the Committee on the Budget, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
